text.en: The majority of clients speak highly of Dr. Shahi, Dr. Cavanaugh, and the veterinary assistants for their attentive explanations and warm bedside manner. Pet parents value that doctors take time to discuss treatment options without rushing. While two reviewers felt pressured by unexpected diagnostic costs and hurried follow-ups, most owners describe an honest and caring clinical team.

title.en: Gentle treatment for dogs and cats

text.en: Clients frequently note how calmly and patiently veterinarians handle nervous puppies, rescue dogs, and elderly cats. Multiple reviewers observe that their pets felt comfortable during dental cleanings, tick treatments, and wellness visits. Aside from one client whose large dog felt overwhelmed during an exam, pet owners consistently report gentle and considerate handling.

Pricing perceptions at the clinic reflect contrasting client experiences. Several pet owners highlight reasonable examination fees and fair procedure estimates, noting good value for a downtown Vancouver practice. In contrast, critical reviews cite dissatisfaction with unexpected re-check fees and high cumulative diagnostic bills, urging greater upfront cost clarity.

q.en: Can pet owners book same-day or last-minute appointments?

a.en: Yes, several clients report getting prompt same-day accommodations for sudden illnesses, tick removals, and urgent assessments.

q.en: How do clients view veterinary costs at this downtown clinic?

a.en: Reviews are divided: many consider fees reasonable and fair for the downtown core, while others report unexpected charges for follow-up visits.

q.en: What procedures do customers frequently mention in reviews?

a.en: Reviewers commonly discuss dental cleanings under sedation, vaccinations, general wellness exams, and tick removal treatments.

q.en: Is online booking supported by Homer Animal Hospital?

a.en: Yes, appointments can be scheduled online or by contacting the clinic directly by phone.
